character: The QS (same voice as Six bids and Column H): a mid-career quantity surveyor, late 30s to 40s, general urban professional New Zealand accent (Auckland or Wellington office), not broad, not rural, not Australian. Here he is reading a vendor's security page out loud across the desk to a procurement lead: calm, dry, completely straight-faced, faintly impressed by an answer that is one word long. Never an announcer, never a sales lift. This is an AI character voice, so it never speaks as the founder. Voice Design fallback: "New Zealander around 40, general NZ accent, urban and professional, not broad, low-mid register, dry and unhurried, close-mic phone recording in a quiet office, conversational, not a narrator or announcer."
casting_line: ISO twenty-seven-oh-oh-one certified? No. In progress. Not certified. Said plainly.
continuous_read_v2:
ISO twenty-seven-oh-oh-one certified?

No.

Same answer. Fifteen languages.

Sock two?

Also no.

Here's what is in place.

Being built now.

In progress. Not certified. Said plainly.

Need this in writing for procurement?

Book a thirty-minute demo at Q-S-me dot build.

lines.on_screen: Is QSME / ISO 27001 / certified? (frame 1, with the chips 'Security questionnaire' · 'Row 1', two empty Y / N boxes and an empty 'Evidence' field). N is ticked in green at 2.78, then the hard cut at 3.0
lines.delivery: Reading row one of the questionnaire off the screen, flat, like the fortieth time this month. 'ISO' as 'eye-so', the number as 'twenty-seven-oh-oh-one'. About 12 syllables in 2.5 s (under 5 a second), so there is room for a flat, unhurried read; the screen already carries 'Is QSME'. A real question, but no upward sales lift; let it fall a touch on 'certified'. Must be out by 2.65 so the N tick (2.78) and the cut (3.0) land in silence.

lines.on_screen: No. (Space Grotesk, 560 px, green full stop) held 3.0-4.6 in silence; 'qsme.build/security' fades in under it at 3.55
lines.delivery: One word, flat and final, a fraction after the cut. No smile, no pause before it, no emphasis. Then nothing at all for the rest of the hold: the silence is the joke.

lines.on_screen: Same answer. 15 languages. (5.6-7.2) over the same FAQ row on qsme.build/de, /fr, /ar, /ru, /ja and /hi security (one every 0.25 s), each first word underlined: Nein. Non. لا. Нет. いいえ。 नहीं।
lines.delivery: Dry aside, a little lower than the hook. A real full stop after 'answer'. Matches the caption word for word.

lines.on_screen: The page's own question 'Do you have a SOC 2 report?' (answer still masked until 7.85)
lines.delivery: 'SOC 2' said 'sock two' (written that way so the voice doesn't spell it). The next row of the form, the same flat read, a little quicker than the hook. Out by 7.8, before the answer is wiped open.

lines.on_screen: Also no. (caption 8.3-9.9) under the highlighted page line 'No. We do not claim one.'
lines.delivery: The tiniest dry shrug in the voice, otherwise flat. Word for word with the caption.

lines.on_screen: Here's what is in place. (caption 10.55-12.8) over 'IN PLACE · What is in place today?' and the TLS card, then a hard cut (10.95) to the 'Bidder visibility rules' card
lines.delivery: A turn: matter-of-fact, a hair warmer than the 'no's, like turning the page round to show someone. Light lean on 'is'. No list, no adjectives.

lines.on_screen: The page sentence underlined 14.6-15.45: 'An information security management system aligned to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is being built now.' (under the page heading 'What is the status of ISO 27001?')
lines.delivery: Reading the end of the highlighted sentence as the underline finishes. Plain, no promise in it, no 'soon'. Out by 15.82.

lines.on_screen: In progress. (15.9) Not certified. (16.6) Said plainly. (17.3), each landing on its own words on the page ('The programme is in progress;' and 'QSME is not certified' tinted green)
lines.text_v2: In progress. Not certified. Said plainly.
lines.text_v3: In progress. Not certified. Said plainly.
lines.delivery: Three short phrases timed to the three caption pops (about 15.9, 16.6, 17.3). Even, unhurried, the last one a touch lower and slower: quiet approval, not a tagline. Word for word with the caption.

lines.on_screen: Full-frame quote: “We do not display / badges, logos or / ratings we have / not earned.” ('not earned.' in green, underlined at 21.08) — qsme.build/security
lines.text_v2: We do not display badges, logos or ratings we have not earned.
lines.text_v3: We do not display badges, logos or ratings we have not earned.
lines.delivery: Reading the quote off the card word for word, no contractions (the screen shows the page's exact sentence, so the voice must not misquote it). About 18 syllables in 3.75 s: even and unhurried, a small beat after 'badges,' and a light lean on 'not earned'. Deadpan respect, not a boast. Out by 23.81.

lines.on_screen: End card: the same questionnaire row as frame 1, now with N ticked; 'Evidence: qsme.build/security' types in at 24.45. (VO only: this is the security page's own CTA heading; it is no longer on screen)
lines.text_v2: Need this in writing for procurement?
lines.text_v3: Need this in writing for procurement?
lines.delivery: A plain, helpful question across the desk, not a pitch, while the evidence line fills in. Out by 25.88.

lines.on_screen: End card: QSME logo · the answered questionnaire row (N ticked, Evidence: qsme.build/security) · green pill 'Book a 30-minute demo at qsme.build' (26.0, small pulse 28.45-28.9)
lines.text_v2: Book a thirty-minute demo at Q-S-me dot build.
lines.text_v3: Book a thirty-minute demo at Q-S-me dot build.
lines.delivery: Friendly and direct, the same voice, no announcer lift and no rise at the end; 'Book' lands just before the green pill pops (26.0). 'Q-S-me dot build' clearly, kyoo-ess-mee. Never 'free' or any pricing line (owner CTA rule 2026-10-03). Out by 28.92.

silences: Deliberate: 2.65-5.6 (the N tick, the 'No.' hold and the match cut into the page), 9.25-10.55 (after 'Also no.', and the whip), 12.3-14.7 (the bidder-rule callback and the scroll to the programme: let the highlight speak), 18.3-20.05 (reading time on the programme paragraph and the badges setup).
post_processing: Primary source: render continuous_read_v2 three times on the chosen voice, slice it and place each piece at its start_s. Patch single lines with previous_text/next_text so the intonation carries. Keep the least polished take; reject any take where 'No.' or 'Also no.' gets a smile or an emphasis, or where the CTA lifts into an announcer read.

Room tone bed (owner phone recording, 60 s of a quiet office) under the whole 30 s at about -50 to -55 dBFS so the silences sound live, never digital zero. Crossfade every VO cut 10-20 ms into the bed.

EQ: high-pass 90-100 Hz, a gentle +1-2 dB presence at 3-4 kHz, -2 dB high shelf above 10 kHz if it is hissy. Light compression only (2:1). Loudness about -16 LUFS integrated for LinkedIn/YouTube, true peak -1 dBTP.
